TraceCompiler: Skill-Guided Mining and Compilation of LLM Agent Traces into Mostly Deterministic Workflows
TSCG: Deterministic Tool-Schema Compilation for Agentic LLM Deployments
Compiled AI: Deterministic Code Generation for LLM-Based Workflow Automation

outputs_produced.description: Canonical experiment result with metrics, controls, observations, validity notes, unresolved
Detailed execution report with system-by-system extractions, control results, decision rule assessment
Reproducibility metadata: sources, repos, environment, frozen input hashes

extraction_methodology.approach: Source-verified extraction from primary sources (arXiv HTML versions) per MV1-MV6 gates
extraction_methodology.mv1_compliance: All extractions include verbatim quotes with section/table/figure references from primary sources
extraction_methodology.mv2_compliance: Runnability verified via GitHub repo inspection (RightNow-AI/auto, SKZL-AI/tscg) and paper claims; not independent execution
extraction_methodology.mv3_compliance: Task distribution comparability explicitly assessed for each system vs SPIDER's synthetic 40-task alias-OOD (locally-served multi-endpoint HTTP with parameterized identifiers)
extraction_methodology.mv4_compliance: Compilation-vs-inheritance distinction maintained; conflations explicitly flagged for each system
extraction_methodology.mv5_compliance: Regime boundaries extracted as numerical thresholds where reported; COVENANT explicitly states 'no net efficiency result' recorded as absent
extraction_methodology.mv6_compliance: Staleness/forgetting/maintenance recorded as reported values or 'not reported' (not assumed zero)

null_control_execution.method: Full-text search of all five paper HTML versions for three fabricated claim strings
claims_tested: zero-shot open-vocabulary goal resolution with <5% error rate
automatic cross-site transfer without any site-specific configuration
forgetting/staleness maintenance cost <1% of build cost
null_control_execution.result: Zero occurrences in all five papers
null_control_execution.tool: Browser find / grep on HTML content

positive_control_execution.method: Re-extraction of MV6 no-memory deterministic executor parameters from same primary sources used in EXP-INTEL-36249068574
parameters_verified: Hot-path latency 18.2µs-4.5ms (Auto Table 3, Compiled AI Table 1)
Token cost per repeat 0 (TSCG Abstract, Compiled AI Table 1)
Abstention/refusal present (Auto gate-refused, COVENANT refusal, Compiled AI validation)
positive_control_execution.result: All parameters match prior extraction within stated precision

c1_addressing_open_nl.evidence: AgentJIT (arXiv:2604.09718) achieves open NL goal resolution via one-shot LLM compilation with published error rate 80-94% compilation success (Table 2)

c2_regime_boundaries_extractable.evidence: 3+ systems with numerical thresholds: AgentJIT (reuse M=500, cost $0.002-$0.092, O(M×N)→O(1)); TraceCompiler/Auto (K=8, 87.1%, 6.4x, 48.9% silent wrongness); Compiled AI (break-even n=17, 57x/450x/40x gains)

c3_comparability_assessed.evidence: All 5 systems explicitly assessed vs SPIDER alias-OOD; all INCOMPARABLE on key dimensions

c4_runnability_verified.evidence: Only 2/5 systems runnable without LLM key/browser/docker: TSCG (arXiv:2605.04107) and TSCG (prior packet). AgentJIT, TraceCompiler/Auto, COVENANT/TraceCompiler, Compiled AI all require LLM access.

c5_conflation_flagged.evidence: All conflations explicitly identified: AgentJIT (CLEAN), TraceCompiler/Auto (CONFLATION), COVENANT/TraceCompiler (CONFLATION), TSCG (CLEAN), Compiled AI (MOSTLY CLEAN), TSCG prior (CLEAN)
